text: Impressions are of three kinds: impulse, conceptualization, and stabilizer. Impulse is the non-recurrence of the fourfold [elements] beginning with earth. Conceptualization is the mental modification consisting of mere imagination, which arises from experience and is the cause of memory. The stabilizer is that which causes one who has been altered to return to that same state; it is the modification of the state [of the result].
